## Verification

- [ ] Normal-case test
- [ ] Boundary or adversarial test
- [ ] `ruff check .`
- [ ] `ruff format --check .`
- [ ] `pytest --cov`
- [ ] Terminal capture or CLI smoke test when visible behaviour changed
- [ ] Wheel build/install smoke test when packaging changed
- [ ] Agent tool boundary test when model behaviour changed
- [ ] Synthetic data is explicitly labelled
- [ ] No confidential data or credentials are included
